notes.title: The Supercharged Update
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce the launch of The Supercharged Update filled with UPGRADES that will supercharge your gameplay!

🔍 [b]Loot & Life[/b]: Explore every corner to uncover valuable rewards and claim your riches. Boost your health with health upgrades to power up your run! And now, you can even revive… but at a price!

⚔️ [b]Arsenal Expansion[/b]: Power up your mech with 60 brand-new upgrades and ultimates, giving you even more ways to crush the bugs in style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740245/165fe37b71f79ece60026d31fae66548972c8d2c.gif[/img]

Alongside these new updates, we’ve also enhanced BIG SHOTS with key quality-of-life improvements and essential bug fixes.

Jump into the action now and experience what’s new! Let’s gear up and obliterate those bugs together! 💥

Happy hunting!
The BIG SHOTS Team

notes.title: 🛠️ Small Bug Fix Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We have just updated the game with small bug fixes.

[h2]⚒️Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare bug where the blinds of one of the players didn't go up.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could be stuck in an endless loading screen.
[*] Fixed waves occasionally not starting.
[*] Canisters now transfer from one shift to the next, including the ones in your canister slot.
[*] Credits and XP are now saved on disconnect or quit.
[*] Grunt boss projectiles don't go through the walls anymore.
[*] Mudmuncher boss now has a smaller hitbox.
[*] Your region is now properly saved for the next time you log in.
[/list]

We also fixed a bunch of other minor bugs to improve your gameplay experience!

notes.title: ⏳Overtime Update, Global Leaderboard and MORE!
notes.notes:
Hello Rookies!

We are back on the battlefield once again with a brand new update on BIG SHOTS! This time we are excited to bring you [b]long-waited Overtime update.[/b] 👀 With this update, you will be able to challenge yourself with [b]Modifiers which will change the pace of the game![/b]

[h2]⏳Overtime Update[/h2]

[h3]Modifiers[/h3]
With modifiers, players can upgrade their gameplay experience to the next level! 
[list]
[*] Make yourself comfortable with extra revives - come back to life to fight with alien bugs even more!
[*] Try out the DOOM modifier where you'll feel the movement speed & weapon heat bonus in your blood!
[*] Have you ever imagined a floor made of acid? You don't have to anymore because it's time to bring it to BIG SHOTS! [i](childhood memories here).[/i][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740245/4429b6658498e5aa5b270a554cc33cf4280bfb2e.gif[/img]

[b]...AND MORE![/b] There is something for everybody! Dive into the game and explore the new possibilities.[i] (Price Inc. is not liable for any damages made when playing with modifiers)[/i]

Do you have that [b]competitive[/b] spirit in your blood? Now it's the right time to bring it out! [b]Compare yourself to your friends and colleagues[/b] with the all-new leaderboards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740245/67a6e15166618b0f0606268b0f3e0e4610614105.gif[/img]
[list][*] Rack up the points and try to [b]climb up in the leaderboard[/b], defeating everyone else like a true BIG SHOT! [i]Leaderboards can be found under the Career tab in the Hangar.[/i][/list]

[*] The UI interaction ray for when the player wants to interact with UI has been given a makeover to look better and even more clear.
[*] We added more information to the upgrade acquired screen that includes upgrade rarity, upgrade weapon, and upgrade icon.

Thank you for your support Rookies! [b]It's time to dive into the action![/b]

notes.title: 🦝Dashboard Dazzle Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Dashboard Dazzle Update - Available NOW![/h1]

Hey Rookies! 

[b]Our exciting journey in BIG SHOTS continues[/b] and today - get ready to decorate your Mech with a bunch of [b]new cool cosmetics![/b] Everyone - please welcome our new friends! 🥳 

[h2]🆕 Cosmetics[/h2]
• [b]Cockpit Cosmetics:[/b] You can now choose a Hanger and a Trinket to spruce up your mech’s interior! From Pedro the Racoon, to brand new toilet paper ([i]yes[/i]) there is something for everyone! 👀 [b]Go and check them out![/b]
• [b]Even MORE Cosmetics:[/b] Not only for the inside of your Mech but there are some new gun buddies, hats, and something else. 🐙 You will definitely recognize some of the new cosmetics, right away. 🫵

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nTIAXgZ.gif[/img]
[h2]♻️ Tutorial Changes[/h2]
• [b]What's Going On? :[/b] We have added a little extra to the tutorial intro to give some more lore as to what you are doing and why.
• [b]FREEDOOOM:[/b] You are now able to use all of the rotation settings during the tutorial. Previously we locked the rotation settings to only “Drag Rotation” during the tutorial in order to encourage players to use our new (better) system. But now you are free to use any of the settings!
• [b]Get Over Here! :[/b] We have removed the ‘skip tutorial’ option the very first time a new player starts the game when the tutorial starts automatically. This is because we noticed that a lot of players skipped the tutorial, got frustrated by not knowing the controls in the game, and quit. We definitely understand you guys want to get into the action as fast as possible, but please take 5 minutes to figure the controls out first.
• [b]Bring the Action! :[/b] We’ve added functionality to skip the splash screens at the start of the game. Just press any button!

[h2]🆙Updates[/h2]
• [b]Join us on Discord:[/b] We have added our Discord code in to the game - so that more people will be able to join our Discord and game together. Two is always better than one! 🤜 🤛 
• [b]BOOOOO! :[/b] Made the Mini-Bosses more SCARY! 👻 They now rumble the ground, shaking your Mech and your soul in anticipation!

[h2]🛠️ Major Fixes[/h2]
• We have added some more colliders to allow still you guys to climb and explore, but not soft-lock yourselves. This is for your own protection, please use them responsibly. 👷 

[h2]🛠️ Minor Fixes[/h2]
• Applied several [b]balancing [/b]tweaks.
• Some upgrade descriptions had variables that were not filled correctly. This should now be the case.
• [b]Some posters in the ending scene have been corrected[/b] to the correct ones, go check them out (if you can HA-HA.).
• Some errors were not [b]localized[/b], this should now no longer be the case.
• Fixed an issue with the [b]Flyer Boss stinger colors[/b] not changing as part of the phase changes.
• There was an issue with the first hit on enemies not updating their health bar correctly, displaying it as full. This should no longer be the case and show the correct amount immediately.
• [b]We have adjusted our haptics system[/b] to allow more settings for PlayStation and other platforms.
• We fixed an issue where the music would occasionally desync with the action. This should now no longer happen.
• Previously the Dash indicator light only communicated the cooldown. Now, it also takes fuel into account, as you cannot dash without fuel, so this is now more accurate.

As always, thank you for your feedback and enthusiasm for BIG SHOTS! [b]Keep your eyes on the horizon for upcoming updates![/b]

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch 1.3.0 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]🗒️Patch 1.3.0 is here![/h1]

[h2]🧑‍🔧 Changes[/h2]
Hi everyone, hope you are all having a good day! Here are the details for the latest 1.3.0 patch:

[h3]🥽 General[/h3]
• We have added [b]a new screen to the mech stats panel![/b] You can now see a list of all the upgrades you have acquired throughout your Run!
• [b]We have improved stability across the board[/b] (We realize this is vague but it’s just code refactoring and guard clauses: most actual fixes were contained in the previous Hotfix patch.)
• Purchasing an item while having an empty equipment slot equipped now automatically equips that item.
• We have added lights to the mech’s headlights in the Hangar!
• [b]Bugparts now no longer get collected if your tank is full,[/b] giving your partner a chance to pick more up!
• Made it possible to shoot through fences in maps that have fences.

[h3]🔼 Upgrades[/h3]
• [b]Life Drain and Vampiric Damage have been fixed[/b], we've tuned their numbers as well:
    ┗ Life Drain has a 50% chance to convert 3% of damage done to mech health. (aka: for each 1000 damage you deal you should heal 15 hp.)
    ┗ Vampiric damage has 100% chance to convert 10% of damage done to Mech health. (aka: for each 1000 damage you deal, you deal 900 damage and heal 100 health.) But enemies also do double damage  to you. (NOTE: This is meant to give a “safe” and “unsafe” option, one that supports a little bit constantly, and one with high risk-reward.)
• [b]The Grenade Launcher has been buffed[/b] from 160 to 210 (Note: We received feedback that the Grenade Launcher was quite underpowered compared to the Flak, especially after a few good upgrades. This should make the damage more reliable; from two grenades barely killing a 300hp Grunt to two grenades for sure killing a 300hp Grunt and heavily damaging the ones around it): 
• Grenade direct hit damage has been uptuned from[b] 60 to 80.[/b]
• Grenade AOE damage has been uptuned from [b]100 to 130.[/b]

[h3]🔊 Sounds[/h3]
We have added many more sounds in the hangar and in-game, so keep an ear out!

• Queen makes sounds when changing phases.
• Hangar buttons now make sounds consistently.
• Equipping weapons, cosmetics, and upgrades now make some noise!
• The mechs in the victory scene now make some noise!
• You will get a unique noise after picking an upgrade in-game, depending on their rarity.
• The Slicer and Droughtwave upgrades now have SFX!
• You now get a sound when invited to join a game and receive a friend request!
• We added a sound to our error pop-up, but hopefully you won’t hear that one a lot.

[h3]🛠️ Major Fixes[/h3]
• We have pre-emptively fixed an issue with the “[b]Buy All Cosmetics[/b]” Achievement & Trophy. This should now work even if we remove and add items from the Cosmetics menu. 
• We have fixed issues with the “[b]Explode on Impact[/b]” and “[b]Boobytrap[/b]” Grenade Launcher upgrades: these should now be much easier to use.
• [b]We have resolved issues with the “Life Drain” and “Vampiric Damage” permanent upgrades![/b]

[h3]🛠️ Minor Fixes
[/h3]• We have fixed issues with our enemy navigation, which was causing enemies to get stuck in place.
• We fixed an issue when equipping the “[b]Empty[/b]” item: this should now be much easier to use.
• We have implemented various smaller UI fixes:
• The microphone icons have gotten an update.
• [b]Fixed the Spewer boss missing SFX for their laser attack.[/b]
[b]• Fixed wall visuals in The Abyss.[/b]
• Fixed an issue with the slicer upgrades no showing particles correctly.
• Drastically reduced the the “Immune” text spam when hitting bosses with weapons like Laser and Flamethrower.
• Fixed some surplus text in subtitles.
• Downtuned the particles related to Lifesteal upgrades (they should now accurately convey the amount gained)
• We have fixed some floor colliders having the wrong mask causing loot to fall through floors (Tangled Nest).
• Removed a surplus spawn point in The Yard which causing players to spawn outside of the map.

Please keep the feedback coming on our Discord channel so we can always have a close look! We will continue to work hard to make BIG SHOTS the best experience for you :)

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.1
notes.notes:
[h1]🗒️Hot Fix is LIVE! 📣[/h1]

[h2]🧑‍🔧 Changes[/h2]
Hey everyone, we hope you are having a good Tuesday! Our team is sending out the new hotfix right now so be sure to update your game before you play! 

We want to give another HUGE thank you to everyone who has taken the time to report their bugs in the The Official Big Shots Server⁠ feedback channel on our Discord. [b]You guys are AWESOME! 💪 [/b]Thanks to you we were able to isolate bugs faster. the following have been [b]fixed[/b]:

[h3]🐜Bug Fixes[/h3]
• The achievement “[b]Visit all maps[/b]” has been fixed. This should now unlock correctly.
• Some more fixes with [b]waves not starting/ending have been resolved.[/b] (As a backup we’ve also implemented a failsafe to catch issues and make losing runs like this much less likely.)
• Fixed Instances of the[b] mudmunchers getting stuck in specific situations[/b]. (This also fixes other enemies)
• The issues with [b]upgrades getting randomly removed[/b] are also resolved!

Thank you so much, we will keep working hard for BIG SHOTS community and bring you the best experience! 🫡

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes - Hot Fix #2
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Rookies![/h1]

Our team has been hard at work to fix all of the bugs that you all brought to our attention in the feedback channel on Discord. We've been hard at work and we fixed the following issues:

[h2]🐞Enemies[/h2]

[u][b]The Mudmuncher[/b][/u] [i](the digging enemies)[/i]
• [b]Attack hitboxes have been reduced in size[/b], allowing you to dodge much easier.
• Mudmunchers will now also [b]exit the ground much more often[/b], giving more opportunities to hit them.

[u][b]General[/b][/u]
• The Enemy Waves that spawn during Bosses [b]have been spread out much more[/b], giving breaks between waves and giving you the opportunity to do some heavy damage!
•[b] The Queen’s Stalagmite attack[/b] is now the same size as the Mudmuncher Boss’ Stalagmite attack, making it easier to dodge.
• The Spewer now needs to have an uninterrupted line of sight to a target before attempting to fire a salvo. (This is additionally to also having to succeed in an “Arch” check to see if the projectile would reach).
• [b]Improved Grunt attacks: [/b]They will no longer get stuck outside of attack range when they are close by and can’t attack.

[h2]⛽Locomotion[/h2]

• [b]The Jetpack now uses less fuel,[/b] making it easier to remain afloat and reach some of the higher platforms. (Note: We realized not a lot of players were using the jetpack, so with this tweak, we hope to make the overall jetpack experience more forgiving and rewarding).

[h2]🎯Quality-of-Life[/h2]

• We have added a [b]Recalibrate Button[/b]! You are now able to use the in-game menu to recenter yourself in the Mech and the Hangar! (Note: This is only available on the Steam version).
• You can find it immediately in the Mech Menu when in a run, or under “[b]Settings → Gameplay Settings → Recalibrate[/b]” in the Hangar.

We have added a [b]Seated Disclaimer[/b] to the start of the game. (Note: we saw a lot of content creators standing up in their footage. Everyone is allowed to play standing, but hopefully, this will make it more clear that BIG SHOTS is designed as a seated experience).

[h2]🛠️Major Fixes[/h2]

• [b]Game Stability Improvements! [/b]We have made dozens of changes that should result in a more stable experience and fewer issues overall, as well as transitioning between levels.
• [b]Losing Upgrades: [/b]We have found and solved many issues that may cause players to lose upgrades during a run. That sucks! While we are confident that we have resolved the majority of causes, some edge cases may remain, so make sure to get in touch if this occurs again!
• [b]Endless Loading Screens:[/b] Fixed various instances of internal errors causing the loading screen to never disable
• [b]Fixed an issue with the Fire Rate + Upgrades:[/b] some combinations caused fire rate to reset, causing you not to have the full benefit of all upgrades. This should no longer be the case.
• Fixed an issue where [b]Highroll would reset your damage[/b] to a lower default value after the effect expired. This should no longer be the case.
• Fixed an issue where [b]“Healing” permanent upgrades[/b] (Vampiric and Lifesteal) in certain scenarios would result in the player losing health instead of gaining health. This should no longer be the case.

[h2]🛠️Minor Fixes[/h2]

• [b]Fixed spawn points in some levels that caused Bosses to appear inside of walls.[/b]
• The Jetpack handle texture was improved!
• Corrected fireworks sounds in the victory celebration level.
• Increased font size of the “[b]Searching for Room[/b]” screen.
• Fixed the Queen’s corpse not despawning in the victory celebration level.
• Fixed a Vine being untextured in “[b]The Portal[/b]” level.

[h2]📌Known Issues[/h2]

• [b]We're aware that waves sometimes don't spawn enemies[/b], we're actively focusing on this issue. More information on this is coming soon!

Thank you all so much for the support so far on BIG SHOTS, we will continue to work hard to bring you the best possible experience! 🙌 [b]As always, please keep the feedback coming![/b]

We will see you on the battlefield! 🤜🤛
